description: Executable Candidate single-Spark recipe for vcruz305's MiniMax-M3.1-Flash EXL3 SAGE 2.15bpw pack (428B total, 23B active mixture of experts, 119 GB, language model only) with vLLM and his vllm-exl3 plugin, from vcruz305/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-EXL3-Spark-recipe at d7445a43 (work in progress upstream). It serves the creator's recommended and measured profile q4-48k: 49,152-token context, one sequence, 1,024 batched tokens, q4 (nvfp4 layout) main KV pool of 2,374,395,495 bytes (50,048 tokens) with fp8 indexer and draft KV, block size 128, the hybrid KV cache manager off, MiniMax's DSpark draft (k = 3, TRITON_ATTN, fp8 KV), FULL_DECODE_ONLY graphs for sizes 1 to 4, FlashInfer autotune off, the minimax_m3 reasoning and tool parsers, and a 32,768-token default output cap. The creator publishes no image, so the image is built from his Dockerfile: vllm/vllm-openai:minimax-m31-flash pinned by digest, plus his exllamav3 fork (feat/moe-act3-batched, fdd77361: without its act-3 case every MiniMax MoE layer decodes garbage) and his vllm-exl3 plugin (feat/minimax-q4-prefill, 41fdb7d9), each cloned at its pinned commit and compiled for sm_121, followed by a build-time sm_121 kernel scan of both extensions. The pack repository is public on Hugging Face (the kit's README calls it gated; the API reports it ungated and anonymous downloads work), so the Model needs no token. Memory follows the creator: the profile's explicit KV pool and the engine's default utilization, with his UMA load-hygiene environment (trim after each layer, a 30 s periodic trim, embed aliasing, mimalloc purge and reset delays 0, which the 48K profile needs to survive its first request). The footprint is very tight by the creator's own numbers: 1.28 GiB MemAvailable at ready, 0.73 to 0.78 GiB lowest under load, run under his own guard with a 0.2 GiB floor. The declared peak is the 130,663,231,488-byte total less 0.73 GiB less the 5,012,574,208-byte idle use, an estimate until the hardware try measures it, and the platform's memory guard may refuse or stop it. The creator's other measured profiles (q4-32k with about 0.8 GiB more headroom, fp8-24k, fp8-16k) are not packaged; creator speeds (about 29 to 30 tok/s, 379 tok/s prefill) are claims until measured here. License: MiniMax Community License (free for non-commercial use; commercial use has attribution and notice conditions; prohibited-use appendix) for the weights, shown as information only; the plugin is AGPL-3.0-only and the recipe scripts MIT.
title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash EXL3 SAGE 2.15bpw vLLM single Spark
